questions.stem: A patient with chronic kidney disease has the following laboratory reports. Calculate the anion gap in this patient. Na + : 145 mEq/L K + : 4 mEq/L Cl - : 90 mEq/L HCO 3 - : 20 mEq/L
questions.stemHtml:
A patient with chronic kidney disease has the following laboratory reports. Calculate the anion gap in this patient.

K+: 4 mEq/L
